intro.title: What does Exyconn build for gyms and sports clubs?
intro.definition: is a set of agents that answers membership enquiries, books trials and classes, sends renewal reminders and keeps in touch with members between sessions, so the front desk and trainers spend their time on the gym floor. Exyconn designs, builds and runs these agents on your gym management software, your biometric or QR access system and your WhatsApp Business account. Trainers still write the programmes; the agent keeps members on them.

benefits.title: Why gyms are doing this now

items.text: Prospects compare three gyms on Instagram and WhatsApp in an evening. The first one to reply with a trial slot usually gets the visit.
Members rarely cancel out loud. They stop coming, and the renewal date arrives with nobody having asked why.
Front desks are thin at 6am and 9pm, which is exactly when members want to book and ask questions.
A no-show in a 20-spot spin class is a bike someone on the waitlist would have taken.
Renewals collected on time matter more to a gym's cash flow than any new joining offer.

props.label: The reality
props.title: Where a gym's hours actually go
props.lede: Ask any club manager what eats the week and it is rarely the training. It is everything around it.

items.title: Enquiries that go cold overnight
items.text: Instagram DMs and WhatsApp messages about fees arrive at 11pm. By the time someone replies the next afternoon, the prospect has walked into the gym down the road.

items.title: Class lists managed by hand
items.text: Popular batches fill in minutes while others run half-empty. Cancellations come in by message and the waitlist lives in someone's notebook.

items.title: Renewals chased one call at a time
items.text: Expiry lists are exported, then staff phone members between check-ins. Lapsed members are often spotted only when the biometric scanner refuses them.

items.title: Members who drift away unnoticed
items.text: Attendance data sits in the access system, but nobody has time to look for the member who went from four visits a week to none.

items.title: Trainers buried in follow-up messages
items.text: Diet questions, plan tweaks and "can we move Thursday?" land on a trainer's personal phone, mixed in with everything else.

items.title: No single view across branches
items.text: Footfall, PT sessions sold, collections and dues sit in different exports, so owners compare branches from spreadsheets at the end of the month.

offerings.title: Six jobs AI takes off your team's plate

items.title: Membership enquiries and free trials
items.text: Answers fee, timing and facility questions on WhatsApp, Instagram and web chat from your current price list, then books a trial slot and logs the lead in your gym software with its source.

items.title: Class bookings and waitlists
items.text: Members book, cancel and swap batches in chat. When someone drops out, the next person on the waitlist gets the spot and a confirmation, and the class roster updates for the instructor.

items.title: Renewals and payment reminders
items.text: Sends reminders ahead of expiry with a payment link or UPI option, records the payment against the membership and raises the GST invoice through your billing system. Freezes and plan changes go to staff.

items.title: Personal plans and check-ins
items.text: Shares the plan a trainer has written, checks in after sessions and logs how the member is feeling. Questions about pain, injury or medical conditions go straight to the trainer, never answered by the agent.

items.title: Churn-risk alerts
items.text: Watches check-in data from your biometric or QR access system and alerts the branch manager when a member's visits drop off, with a suggested message to send while there is still time.

items.title: Attendance and revenue reports
items.text: Footfall by hour, class fill rates, PT sessions, collections and upcoming renewals per branch, sent to owners on WhatsApp or email each morning.

props.lede: Follow a normal Monday. Each moment lights the part of the club the agent is working on.

moments.title: A spot opens in the 6am spin class
moments.text: A member cancels from bed. The first person on the waitlist gets the bike and a confirmation before the instructor has opened the studio.

moments.title: Overnight numbers reach the owner
moments.text: Yesterday's footfall at both branches, PT sessions completed, collections and this week's expiries arrive as one WhatsApp summary.

moments.title: Renewal reminders go out
moments.text: Members whose plans end in ten days get a note with a payment link. Two pay straight away; one asks to freeze for a month and is handed to the desk.

moments.title: A regular has gone quiet
moments.text: A member who trained four times a week has not checked in for 12 days. The branch manager gets an alert and a draft message to send personally.

moments.title: Post-session check-in
moments.text: After her PT session, a member gets her week's plan from Coach Arjun and is asked how her shoulder felt. She mentions a twinge, and the note goes to Arjun.

moments.title: A late-night enquiry becomes a trial
moments.text: Someone who saw a reel asks about couple memberships. The agent explains the plans and books a trial for Wednesday evening.

items.question: Will this replace our front desk or sales staff?
items.answer: No. It handles the repeated questions, bookings and reminders so your team can show prospects around, sell PT and look after members in the building. Price negotiations, freezes, refunds and complaints are passed to a person with the conversation attached.

items.question: Does it work with our gym management software and biometric machines?
items.answer: If your gym software has an API or a reliable export, yes. Most biometric and QR access systems can share check-in logs, either directly or through the gym software. In the first week we confirm what your setup exposes and what the agent can read or update.

items.question: Can the AI give workout or diet advice?
items.answer: Only what your trainers have written for that member. It can share the plan, remind members of sessions and log how they feel. Anything about pain, injury, medical conditions or supplements goes to a trainer, and the agent says so plainly.

items.question: What about members' personal and health data?
items.answer: Data stays in your systems and in an environment set up for your gym, with role-based access and a log of every conversation. Health notes are kept to what trainers need, and the setup follows the privacy law that applies, such as India's DPDP Act 2023 or the GDPR.

items.question: Which languages can members use?
items.answer: Members can write in English, Hindi and other Indian languages, or a mix of both, and the agent replies in kind. Your price list and policies are written once and stay the same in every language.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of branches, channels and systems. Most gyms start with enquiries and renewals on WhatsApp for one branch. Tell us how you run today and we'll send a fixed quote for the first phase.
